title: Embedding validation harness: golden sets, offline metrics & drift alerts
creator: Jonah Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated, reproducible evaluation harness for embeddings and reranking endpoints that produces deterministic offline metrics from golden test sets, surfaces drift signals, and integrates into Redwood Console and our CI gating for model rollouts.

Scope:
- Golden sets: curated relevance pairs and ranking judgments for high-value customers and internal datasets.
- Offline metrics: recall@k, MRR, NDCG@k, mean cosine similarity distributions, pairwise AUC for reranker ordering, embedding drift statistics (centroid shift, covariance change, KL-like distance on binned similarity).
- Drift monitoring: daily/weekly batch comparisons, continuous rolling-window signal, and alerting thresholds with runbook links.
- Pipeline: ingest golden sets from secure S3 bucket, run evaluation jobs in batch compute (k8s jobs or managed batch), store results in Observability DB and push to Console dashboards.
- CI/rollout gating: evaluation job as part of model rollout workflow; block rollouts when critical regression detected.

Non-goals for this ticket: real-time online A/B evaluation (will be tracked in a follow-up), ground-truth collection tooling for new customers, or embedding training improvements.

Design notes and trade-offs:
- Golden set maintenance: maintain small, high-quality golden sets per domain (search, semantic-similarity, Q&A retrieval) rather than attempting broad coverage. Pros: focused signal, low compute; Cons: may not catch rare regressions.
- Metric choice: prefer ranking-focused metrics (NDCG, MRR) for reranker scenarios and embedding distribution statistics for embedding-only endpoints. We will still compute basic cosine/hamming distribution stats to detect mode collapse.
- Compute placement: run evaluations as scheduled k8s jobs in dedicated evaluation namespace with autoscaling. For larger golden sets use spot nodes to reduce cost but with retry fallback to on-demand when spot unavailable.
- Alerting sensitivity: start with conservative thresholds (e.g., >5% relative drop in NDCG or >0.1 drop in mean cosine similarity) and iterate after 2 weeks of noisy false positives.

Data sources and golden set creation:
- Internal: support team provided labeled search relevance sets (SRE-search-golden v1), previous customer eval packs (anonymized), and synthetic paraphrase expansions.
- External: licensed open datasets (MS MARCO snippets, NQ subsets) for baseline metrics.
- Label schema: for reranking tasks provide graded relevance (0/1/2). For similarity tasks provide binary match and human confidence score.
- Versioning: golden sets stored immutable under s3://redwood-eval/goldens/{domain}/{version}/manifest.json and referenced by evaluation config.

Outputs and integrations:
- Per-run artifacts: raw pairwise distances, ranking lists, aggregated metrics JSON, and evaluation logs.
- Console: new Console panel under 'Embeddings' with per-model historical charts for primary metrics, anomaly flags, and the last-run downloadable artifact link.
- Alerts: PagerDuty + Slack channel #embeddings-eval for critical regressions, lower-severity Slack digests for drift warnings.
- Rollout gating: evaluation outcome included in the model deployment pipeline; deployment fails with link to artifact and diff report if regression exceeds threshold.

Acceptance criteria (high-level):
- Harness can execute scheduled and on-demand runs against at least three golden sets (search, similarity, reranker) and produce reproducible metrics.
- Console shows historical charts for NDCG@10, MRR, recall@5, mean cosine similarity, and a clear pass/fail status per model version.
- Alerts configured and tested: simulated regression triggers PagerDuty and posts digest to #embeddings-eval.
- CI gating: model rollout job demonstrates blocking behavior when a critical regression is present (test mode).

Success metrics after launch:
- False positive alert rate below 30% after two-week tuning period.
- Detectable regressions verified by product/ML lead on >=90% of synthetic regression tests.
- Evaluation run latency (end-to-end for medium-size golden set ~10k pairs) under 30 minutes in nominal cluster conditions.
